role_definitions.formal: reproducible clean-source evidence eligible for performance or matched-system claims
role_definitions.diagnostic: reconstructable non-formal evidence; dirty runs require a retained patch artifact
role_definitions.legacy-unreconstructable: historical evidence with incomplete run reproducibility; raw-data availability, statistic recomputability and source reconstruction must be assessed separately in reproducibility; never formal merely because some statistics can be recomputed
role_definitions.source-audit: current source supports semantic claims only, not measured performance
role_definitions.external-source-audit: dated external or pinned sources that must be rechecked before current-state citation
role_definitions.historical-record: Historical observation summary after raw artifacts were deliberately removed; not independently recomputable or formal performance evidence.
